user.title: Connect to VeSync
user.description: Use a separate VeSync account with the fryer shared to it. Signing in replaces other sessions for this account.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to VeSync again
reauth_confirm.description: The session has expired. Submitting this form replaces other sessions for this account.

error.no_fryer: No CS358-AF found on this account.
error.multiple_fryers: Share exactly one CS358-AF with this account.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the original account.

command_refused.message: The fryer refused the command in its current state.

not_preheated.message: Start cooking is only available after preheating has finished.

auth_failed.message: The VeSync session has expired. Sign in again in the integration settings.

command_failed.message: Unable to complete the fryer command.

choose_account.message: Select exactly one loaded Cosori config entry.

invalid_temperature.message: Temperature must be 170–400 °F in 10 °F steps. Celsius is rounded to the nearest step.

invalid_minutes.message: Minutes must be a whole number from 1 to 60.

start_cook.name: Start cook
start_cook.description: Start a manual cook, optionally with preheat.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Uses your Home Assistant temperature unit unless temperature_unit is supplied. Celsius is rounded to the nearest 10 °F; the resulting setting must be 170–400 °F.

preheat.name: Preheat
preheat.description: Preheat before cooking. The fryer chooses the preheat duration.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Required when more than one account is configured.
